llm_response.reason: The website operates as a Florida real estate agency, offers legitimate property listings and investment information, makes only optimistic but plausible claims (6-9% property value increase), provides clear business contact info and agent certification, and has been registered since 2004 with consistent ownership. There are no signs of typical scam characteristics such as guaranteed returns, unusually low prices, free offers, urgency tactics, remote access requests, pop-up scams, or non-existent companies. SSL issues are noted, but do not inherently signal a scam.
